name: activation
label: Keyboard activation
inline_help_text: Automatic switches tabs as the arrow keys move focus. Manual waits for Enter or Space.

default.label: Marketers
default.title: Build the page yourself
default.content: Open the page editor, drag a module into a section, fill in the fields. Headings, spacing and colours are already decided, so the result looks finished the first time.

default.label: Designers
default.title: Change the brand in one place
default.content: Theme settings hold the palette, fonts and spacing. Adjust them once and every page, old and new, follows.

default.label: Developers
default.title: Ship with confidence
default.content: Modules are plain HubL, CSS and vanilla JavaScript. Run npm test before hs upload to catch undeclared fields and off-brand colours.
